resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO DFT package
resources.access: Open-source DFT code (https://www.quantum-espresso.org/). Install via package manager (e.g., conda install -c conda-forge qe).

resources.name: Be pseudopotential (LDA)
resources.access: SSSP efficiency library (https://www.materialscloud.org/discover/sssp/table) or generate on-the-fly.

resources.name: N pseudopotential (LDA)
resources.access: SSSP efficiency library (https://www.materialscloud.org/discover/sssp/table) or generate on-the-fly.

resources.name: Crystal structure of β-Be3N2
resources.access: Hexagonal P6_3/mmc (No. 194), a_exp=2.841 Å, c_exp=9.693 Å (Eckerlin & Rabenau, Z. Anorg. Allg. Chem. 304, 218, 1960, DOI: 10.1002/zaac.19603040410).

resources.name: Crystal structure of α-Be3N2
resources.access: Cubic Ia-3 (No. 206), a_exp=8.145 Å (Reckeweg et al., Z. Naturforsch. B 58, 159, 2003, DOI: 10.1515/znb-2003-0205).
